en: In the next section, I will no longer attempt a production-only bridge. zh: R0.73X 留下的 signed-to-positive coercivity 桥，至少在 production-only 形式下是假的。存在一整个光滑、零均值的周期 Navier--Stokes exact shear 类：对每个实振幅，\(\Pi_s=\mathscr S_s=Q_s=0\) 在所有正 heat 尺度上成立；对每个非零振幅 \(A\ne0\)，\(D_{ii,s}>0\) 逐点严格成立；零振幅成员是平凡场，且 \(D_{ii,s}=0\)。因而，零输入上取零的 production-only functional 不可能给出振幅无关的有限 coercive modulus。这是 exact no-go theorem，不是正则性判据。
en: The signed-to-positive coercivity bridge left by R0.73X is false, at least in its production-only form. There is an entire class of smooth, zero-mean, periodic exact Navier--Stokes shear solutions: for every real amplitude, \(\Pi_s=\mathscr S_s=Q_s=0\) holds at every positive heat scale; for every nonzero amplitude \(A\ne0\), \(D_{ii,s}>0\) holds strictly pointwise; the zero-amplitude member is the trivial field, and \(D_{ii,s}=0\). Therefore, a production-only functional that vanishes at zero input cannot provide an amplitude-independent finite coercive modulus. This is an exact no-go theorem, not a regularity criterion.

It will first freeze a positive observable of the same degree of homogeneity: exactly verify the scaling, finiteness, and suitable-weak positive-scale definition in (7.1); classify the zero-production kernel on the rank-one orthogonal shear class; pressure-test it against two-mode, pressure-active, and local-cutoff probes; propose a precise quotient-coercivity theorem only after the first three gates pass; and record every failure as an exact counterexample, without presenting a conjecture as a theorem.

en: The exact shear NSE provides an analytic obstruction: for every real amplitude, zero production at every positive scale; strictly positive heat covariance holds only when A != 0, and it is zero when A = 0. This only rules out production-only coercivity; Vreman (2004) already directly covers the basic shear overlap, so I do not claim novelty or priority for this mechanism. analytic exact witness / not DNS; NOT CLAY.
